test_title: PYST 42: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement(s) is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statement:

All grapes are apples.

All apples are kiwis.

Some kiwis are bananas.

Conclusion:

(1) All apples are bananas.

(II) Some kiwis are grapes.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

All grapes are apples.

All apples are kiwis.

Some kiwis are bananas.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94926a3cca2a3aa2a62330d7fc3534333197b77c819e0c08b35d2eafdc997850.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All apples are bananas - **False** (Because there is no definite relation given between apples and bananas. Only a part of kiwis is bananas, and apples are a part of kiwis, but there is no direct connection established between apples a
nd bananas.)

II. Some kiwis are grapes - **True** (Because 'All grapes are apples' and 'All apples are kiwis.' This means that all grapes are a part of kiwis, which logically implies that some kiwis are grapes.)

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
